description: Source code for an Odoo wizard module that generates a partner balance report based on user-selected date or period filters.

classes.name: wizard_report
classes.description: A wizard interface class for generating partner balance reports with date/period filters.

methods.name: _get_defaults
methods.description: Initializes default values for the wizard form, including fiscal year, periods, and company.

methods.name: _check_state
methods.description: Checks the selected date/period filter state and validates date range if needed.

methods.name: _check_date
methods.description: Validates that the selected date range falls within an existing fiscal year.
